description: Tata letak untuk mode teks Muse. Hanya posisi headline, subjek, poin, dan footer. Adegan dan gaya teks ditentukan Muse.

L1.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic
L1.prompt_template: Bold editorial social media poster in {aspect}, in the style of a modern campaign. The main visual is {subject}, shown as a realistic high-quality studio photograph with premium lighting and realistic materials; choose a fitting, natural scene, and keep any people natural and friendly. The background is a seamless matte {ink} wall with a soft vignette. In the top third, a huge headline in {headline_style}, left aligned, white with the last two words in {accent}, reads exactly "{headline}". The subject sits in the lower two thirds, slightly right of center.

L2.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic
L2.prompt_template: Bold social media poster in {aspect}, in the style of a modern digital-agency campaign. The background is a crumpled warm cream paper texture with soft creases and subtle shadows. In the center right, a high-contrast black and white cutout photograph of {subject}, with a single {accent} detail as the only color, sharp paper-cut edge and a light drop shadow. A large {ink} geometric block sits behind it at the lower left for depth. In the upper left, a huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, reads exactly "{headline}", with the last two words highlighted by a {accent} marker-style bar behind them.

L3.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic
L3.prompt_template: Bold typography-led social poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink} with a subtle crumpled paper texture and a soft lighter glow in the center. In the center, a huge stacked headline in {headline_style}, cream with one key word in {accent}, reads exactly "{headline}". Around it float two or three small realistic objects related to {subject}, tilted like stickers with thin white borders, with soft shadows.

L4.concept: Blok headline atas, foto penuh di bawah
L4.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic
L4.prompt_template: Clean editorial social poster in {aspect}. The top third is a flat warm cream block holding a huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy with one word in {accent}, reads exactly "{headline}". The lower two thirds are a full-bleed realistic photograph of {subject}, natural light, shallow depth of field, graded in {palette}.

L5.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic

chips.where: Under the subline, a short vertical list of three or four rows each beginning with a small round {accent} marker

L5.prompt_template: Structured editorial social poster in {aspect}. The background is solid {ink} with subtle paper grain. On the right half, a realistic cutout photograph of {subject}, with a thin {accent} outline and a soft shadow. In the upper left column, a huge headline in {headline_style}, cream, reads exactly "{headline}".

L6.concept: Foto penuh, headline di sepertiga bawah
L6.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic
L6.prompt_template: Cinematic social poster in {aspect}. A full-frame realistic photograph of {subject}, dramatic soft lighting, graded in {palette}. In the lower third, on a soft dark gradient, a huge headline in {headline_style}, cream with the last word in {accent}, reads exactly "{headline}".

L7.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic

chips.where: In the middle and lower area, tilted outlined pill-shaped capsules in cream with thick rounded borders cross each other like a playful word cloud, with bold condensed navy capitals, one of them filled {accent}

L7.prompt_template: Typography poster in {aspect}. The background is a crumpled warm cream paper texture. At the top, a huge headline in {headline_style}, deep navy, centered, reads exactly "{headline}". A small realistic object related to {subject} peeks in from the lower corner.

L8.concept: Dua blok warna dengan cutout di tengah
L8.subject_hint: a concrete, natural scene or object that fits the topic
L8.prompt_template: Bold campaign poster in {aspect}. The canvas is split diagonally into a {ink} half and a warm cream half. A realistic cutout photograph of {subject}, sharp paper-cut edge with a light shadow, sits across the split. On the navy half, a huge headline in {headline_style}, cream with one word in {accent}, reads exactly "{headline}".
